summary: Frontend-only verification of the 3 rewritten hero sections (Instruments, MusicMeditation, Events) and the scroll-aware Header refactor. All acceptance criteria met: Instruments uses cream split-layout hero (bg rgb(245,240,229)) with orange BackLink/eyebrow, h1 76px, Udukku image + floating 20+ chip; MusicMeditation uses warm cream hero (rgb(245,237,222) ~= #F5EDDE) with 104px h1 'Music as medicine.', italic-serif quote block, Breath/Sound/Stillness chips; Events uses full-bleed real Udukku photo hero (min-h ~86vh -> 929px on 1080 viewport) with white 'Where music becomes community.' headline and orange italic 'community'. Header logo/nav variants render correctly per page/scroll state.
critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: scroll listener uses `passive:true` and a strict `> 40` threshold; noticed a tiny lag where at scrollY~96 the state momentarily still reads pre-scroll during rapid programmatic scrolls (Playwright window.scrollTo without dispatch). Not user-facing; native wheel/touch fires listener fine.

Instruments.jsx / Events.jsx / MusicMeditation.jsx: hero images from customer-assets.emergentagent.com are large JPGs served without srcset; consider width-based responsive sources or an image CDN transform to reduce mobile payload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified logo cross-fade via getComputedStyle on both variants in [data-testid=header-logo-link]. Verified nav color via computed color on [data-testid^=nav-link]. To assert scroll behavior on /services/events reliably, do window.scrollTo(0,y) AND window.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')) then wait >=300ms; page.mouse.wheel also works but a plain page.evaluate scrollTo may not trigger React state within Playwright. At y>=500 nav flips to brown-dark rgb(45,26,10), and dark-logo opacity crosses 1 by y~=1000. Music Room stays light logo + white nav throughout (dark theme). /services landing has no footer, /services/* sub-pages have footer.
